title: Variability of Antarctic Sea Ice Extent in the Prydz Bay Region (2003-2024)
description: Prototype study analysing two decades of satellite-derived sea ice concentration and drift records to characterise seasonal and inter-annual variability of sea ice extent in the Prydz Bay region of East Antarctica.
institution: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)

title: Recent Warming and Hydrographic Changes in the Fram Strait
description: Prototype study examining moored and ship-based observations that document recent upper-ocean warming and changing sea ice conditions in the Fram Strait between Greenland and Svalbard.
institution: National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC)

title: Glacier Front Dynamics of the Svalbard Archipelago
description: Prototype study tracking the positions of marine-terminating glacier fronts across the Svalbard archipelago using optical and radar satellite imagery to quantify glacier retreat patterns.
institution: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)

title: Phytoplankton Bloom Dynamics in the Southern Ocean
description: Prototype study combining satellite ocean-colour observations with in-situ measurements to describe the seasonal development of phytoplankton blooms over Southern Ocean shelf and open-ocean regions.

title: Sea Ice Retreat and Krill Larval Survival in the Southern Ocean
description: Prototype study linking the timing of seasonal sea ice retreat to Antarctic krill larval survival, highlighting the dependency of the Southern Ocean food web on sea ice habitat.

title: Black Carbon and Aerosol Observations at a Coastal Antarctic Station
description: Prototype analysis of continuous aerosol and black carbon measurements from a coastal Antarctic observatory, documenting seasonal cycles and episodic pollution events in pristine polar air.
institution: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)

title: Antarctic Sea Ice Concentration Daily Gridded Product (2003-2024)
description: Prototype gridded daily sea ice concentration product for the Antarctic region derived from passive-microwave satellite observations, suitable for climate variability and trend studies.
institution: National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC)

title: Arctic Ocean Temperature and Salinity Profile Collection (1990-2023)
description: Prototype collection of temperature and salinity profiles from the Arctic Ocean and Fram Strait, assembled from research cruises and ice-tethered instruments for polar oceanography studies.
institution: National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC)

title: Svalbard Glacier Front Position Inventory (1985-2022)
description: Prototype inventory of glacier front positions for the marine-terminating glaciers of Svalbard, digitised from satellite imagery as a time series supporting long-term glacier monitoring.
institution: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)

title: Southern Ocean Krill Biomass Survey Data (2024)
description: Prototype survey dataset of Antarctic krill biomass and distribution, collected with scientific echosounders and net samples during a Southern Ocean ecosystem survey.

title: Coastal Antarctic Meteorological and Aerosol Time Series (2020-2025)
description: Prototype time series of meteorological parameters and aerosol concentrations recorded at a prototype coastal Antarctic observation site in support of atmospheric studies.
institution: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)

title: Prydz Bay Sea Ice Process Study Expedition
description: Prototype expedition description. A multi-week Antarctic field campaign in Prydz Bay combining ice-station work, CTD casts and sea ice coring to support sea ice process studies.
institution: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)

title: Fram Strait Arctic Ocean Transect
description: Prototype expedition description. An Arctic oceanographic transect across the Fram Strait deploying moorings and profiling instruments to monitor the inflow of warm Atlantic water to the Arctic.
institution: National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC)

title: Southern Ocean Ecosystem Survey Expedition
description: Prototype expedition description. A Southern Ocean survey mapping krill swarms, hydrography and predator activity to support biodiversity and ecosystem research.

title: Antarctic Coastal Atmospheric Observation Campaign
description: Prototype expedition description. A field campaign installing and servicing atmospheric and meteorological instruments at a coastal Antarctic site in Dronning Maud Land.
institution: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)

title: Dr. Ananya Desai
description: Prototype researcher profile. Polar remote-sensing scientist studying Antarctic sea ice variability and coastal atmospheric observations using satellite and in-situ records.
institution: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)

title: Dr. Mikkel Johansen
description: Prototype researcher profile. Polar climatologist working on Arctic ocean hydrography and satellite-based glacier monitoring datasets for the polar regions.
institution: National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC)

title: Dr. Sofia Marino
description: Prototype researcher profile. Marine ecologist studying Antarctic krill populations, phytoplankton blooms and sea-ice dependent ecosystems in the Southern Ocean.

title: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)
description: Prototype institutional profile. India’s national polar research institute coordinating Antarctic and Arctic programmes, Southern Ocean research, glaciology and polar data stewardship.

title: British Antarctic Survey (BAS)
description: Prototype institutional profile. A polar research institute delivering and coordinating United Kingdom science in Antarctica and the Southern Ocean.

title: National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC)
description: Prototype institutional profile. A United States data centre that archives and distributes cryosphere and polar climate datasets to the research community.
